title: AuditTapPolicy v1 — the audit tap as data: the law is constants — the tap stands OFF by default (default_state always off), it may be turned on only with a named operator's stated consent (consent_required always true), it can only ever observe — never write, inject, or alter fabric traffic (read_only always true) — and while it is on it is loud about it (announce_when_on always true: its enabling and disabling are always recorded and evented, never silent); max_events bounds the retained feed and type_filter names the only event types retained (an empty filter retains every type) (Y-071)
